 pcs (0.11.7-1ubuntu1) noble; urgency=medium
 
   * Merge with Debian unstable (LP: #2040410). Remaining changes:
diff --git a/debian/patches/lp2168936-line-wrapping.patch b/debian/patches/lp2168936-line-wrapping.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8b27d3c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/lp2168936-line-wrapping.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+From bd3bc07b8a9b9daabaaff20ad658e649c94fd8f1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Tomas Jelinek <tojeline@redhat.com>
+Date: Thu, 16 May 2024 10:36:23 +0200
+Subject: [PATCH] fix stdout wrapping to terminal width
+Origin: upstream https://github.com/ClusterLabs/pcs/commit/bd3bc07b8a9b9daabaaff20ad658e649c94fd8f1
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/docker.io/+bug/2168936
+---
+ CHANGELOG.md             | 3 +++
+ pcs/cli/common/output.py | 8 +++++---
+ 2 files changed, 8 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
+
+diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
+index d79946280..ff7cfe5ec 100644
+--- a/CHANGELOG.md
++++ b/CHANGELOG.md
+@@ -36,6 +36,8 @@
+   booth site address parameter is needed ([rhbz#2232143])
+ - When moving or banning a resource in a bundle, pcs now errors out instead of
+   creating a move / ban constraint which does nothing ([RHEL-7744])
++- Do not wrap pcs output to terminal width if pcs's stdout is redirected
++  ([RHEL-36514])
+ 
+ ### Changed
+ - When exporting constraints in form of pcs commands, constraints containing
+@@ -67,6 +69,7 @@
+ [rhbz#2232143]: https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2232143
+ [rhbz#2234717]: https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2234717
+ [RHEL-7744]: https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHEL-7744
++[RHEL-36514]: https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHEL-36514
+ 
+ 
+ ## [0.11.6] - 2023-06-20
+ 
+diff --git a/pcs/cli/common/output.py b/pcs/cli/common/output.py
+index 179f7c03f..9dc0e1621 100644
+--- a/pcs/cli/common/output.py
++++ b/pcs/cli/common/output.py
+@@ -56,9 +56,11 @@ def format_wrap_for_terminal(
+     trim -- number which will be substracted from terminal size. Can be used in
+         cases lines will be indented later by this number of spaces.
+     """
+-    if (sys.stdout is not None and sys.stdout.isatty()) or (
+-        sys.stderr is not None and sys.stderr.isatty()
+-    ):
++    # This function is used for stdout only - we don't care about wrapping
++    # error messages and debug info. So it checks stdout and not stderr.
++    # Checking stderr would enable wrapping in case of 'pcs ... | grep ...'
++    # (stderr is connected to a terminal), which we don't want. (RHEL-36514)
++    if sys.stdout is not None and sys.stdout.isatty():
+         return format_wrap(
+             text,
+             # minimal line length is 40
+
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series

--- a/debian/patches/series
+++ b/debian/patches/series

 fix-clean-target.patch
 0001-Do-not-depend-on-backports.patch
